implementation: Dag wallet admission allocates one exact-capacity handle vector instead of permitting in-place collect to retain arbitrary caller Vec capacity.
Attempt manifests and Arc handle vectors allocate their exact bounded input counts; payload backing remains shared with retained graph records.
Limits::retained_storage and Dag::retained_storage expose a conservative requested-layout bound and a capacity census, with checked component admission.
Rust 1.96 BTree nodes are bounded from all fields, slots, edges and alignment. Charge one internal node per entry plus an empty/insertion root; no allocator/RSS claim.
Store inventory owns exact-length canonical names, aggregates hard-link checks in a bool and sorts pending names without heap scratch.
StoreLimits::inventory_storage includes both inventories plus prune keep-map and removal list; inventory_storage_bytes checks retained capacities.

preliminary_revisions.reason: New test used a nonexistent helper name. Only artifact_store_tests.rs differs; corrected before all successful native suites and GPU proofs.

audit_controller.prior_error: Undefined variable in the new collection service-property check; corrected in a new immutable controller before any audit result was published.

controller_interruption.reason: A new control/collections.py filename shadowed the Python standard-library module on the second qualification launch. No second GPU run started.
controller_interruption.resolution: Immutable original controllers and successful historical proofs retained. control/resume.py uses python3 -P to finish collection validation, device-PCS proofs, standard suite and cleanup.

limitations: These APIs account and admit components only. Aggregate physical coordinator admission is not complete and existing worker/coordinator caps and the 337 MiB per-job floor are unchanged.

The retained DAG bound excludes transition/recovery/snapshot indexes, durable Weak-owner maps, paths, launch/supervisor/fleet queues, caller buffers, allocator overhead and OS storage. The inventory component excludes file/path/directory-iterator storage and artifact read payloads.
The BTree bound depends on the audited Rust 1.96 implementation and conservatively charges mostly unused slots, especially at hard limits. Requalify toolchain changes and other platforms.
Released external Assignment/caller Arc handles require their own lifetime accounting after the DAG drops its last handle; the retained census describes DAG ownership only.

Ordinary admission continues rejecting incomplete versioned phase profiles. Complete worker initialization/per-job/driver composition, broader workloads/live-cache sets, nonempty-child full-size merges, paired throughput comparisons, 24 hours AND 150 completed roots, multiple GPUs and AMD/Metal remain required.

Fresh GPU runs establish proof correctness and resource cleanup, not a throughput improvement. Verification and local-control hashing remain on CPU. Proof parameters, formats, journal bytes, registry identities and activation are unchanged.
